primitives.name: Comprehension Time Bound
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters Users need to find value in 10 seconds.
primitives.assumptions: User engagement is bounded by 10-second attention span; value function V is monotonic in comprehension time T.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T > 10s implies failure of contextual help coverage.

layer2.mapping: The 10-second bound T ≤ 10s is isomorphic to a causal inference problem in GSI where P(V|T≤10s) ≥ threshold.
layer2.telemetry: Average time-to-value metric per user session.

primitives.name: Trust-Safe Media Path
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSE is proprietary and complex, so every major item needs an immediate explanation, a next action, and a trust-safe media or visual path.
primitives.assumptions: Media type M must be verifiable and non-intrusive; trust score S reflects user confidence in media validity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: S < 0.5 implies loss of user trust and reduced help efficacy.

layer2.mapping: The kernel of trust-safe media is derived from empirical validation of M against user feedback and compliance metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Trust score S computed from user retention and feedback after exposure to M.

primitives.name: User Value Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Product Surface - all pages ## User Value Users know what they are seeing, why it matters, how to use it, and what to do next without reading a manual.
primitives.assumptions: V = f(U, A, C) is a composite function of understanding, actionability, and clarity; all components are normalized to [0,1].

layer2.mapping: User value V is isomorphic to a cognitive load model in GSI where V = g(U × A × C) and g is a monotonically increasing function.
layer2.telemetry: Composite value score V computed from user task completion rate and post-exposure survey scores.
